raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (the only 362 rows with source_tz='UTC', ingested 2026-01-19) has txn_ts in UTC, but the silver step treats every txn_ts as local time. Those rows are shifted about 6 hours late, so transactions that happened at 00:00-06:00 Chicago time land on 2026-01-19 with the wrong date and hour. The fix is to convert UTC-tagged timestamps to America/Chicago local time before deriving txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
